falseSynonyms.zh: conversation 可以很輕鬆、雙向；interview 通常有較明確角色，一方負責提問、了解或評估。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We had a relaxed conversation over coffee. The journalist conducted an interview with the minister.

falseSynonyms.zh: discussion 強調共同探討議題；interview 通常仍有 interviewer/interviewee 的角色差異。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The panel held a discussion on housing. The candidate attended an interview for the post.

falseSynonyms.zh: meeting 只表示會面，不保證有問答或評估。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I have a meeting with my manager. I have a job interview with the hiring manager.

falseSynonyms.zh: consultation 的核心是尋求／提供專業意見，而不是評估候選人或採訪。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She booked a medical consultation. She attended an interview for the research study.

falseSynonyms.zh: interrogation 強度遠高於普通 interview，通常帶警方／安全調查與強制盤問意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The journalist interviewed the witness. Police questioned the suspect during an interrogation.

falseSynonyms.zh: oral examination 是口頭考試；interview 可以評估，但不一定按考試標準給分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The candidate attended an interview. The student sat an oral examination.

falseSynonyms.zh: screening 通常是初步篩選階段，範圍和深度都可能小於完整 interview。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The recruiter conducted a ten-minute phone screening. Successful applicants then attended a full interview.

falseSynonyms.zh: interview 是事件／動詞；interviewer 是提問的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The interview lasted forty minutes. The interviewer asked about previous experience.
